turns.user: Can I place a direct order for ₹80,000 of cartons without raising a purchase request first?
turns.agent:
No. A direct purchase order without a request is allowed only when its gross value is ₹50,000 or less. Every other purchase must start with a purchase request.

Source: Purchase Policy §3.3; Purchase Policy §3.1

turns.user: Can I still charge new orders to cost centre PRD-05?
turns.agent:
Yes, but only if PRD-05 is an open cost centre. Every order must be charged to an open cost centre, as a closed cost centre cannot carry new spend. You can check its status in Bahi on screen FIN-CC-01 or ask Finance before raising an order.

Source: Purchase Policy §4.2; Purchase Policy §4.1

turns.user: If Rohit approves my purchase request, does that also cover the purchase order raised against it?
turns.agent:
Yes, approval of a purchase request covers the purchase order raised against it, provided the approver's limit covers the order's gross value.

Source: Purchase Policy §5.4; Purchase Policy §3.4

turns.user: Is my ₹2,50,000 approval limit on the basic value or including GST?
turns.agent:
Yes, your limit includes GST. Under Purchase Policy §5.1, limits apply to the gross value including GST, not the basic value.

Source: Purchase Policy §5.1; Purchase Policy §3.3
